title: Basic Science practice
subject: basic_science
source: Written by the Magana team. Our own wording; not past questions. CC BY 4.0.
review: Sample: to be reviewed by a Basic Science teacher before testing with learners.

questions.question: Which part of a plant takes in water from the soil?
questions.explanation: Roots take in water from the soil.

questions.question: What do we call animals that eat only plants?
questions.explanation: Herbivores eat only plants, like goats and cows.

questions.question: Which organ pumps blood around the body?
questions.explanation: The heart pumps blood around the body.

questions.question: What happens to water when it gets very cold?
questions.explanation: Very cold water freezes into ice.

questions.question: Which gas do we breathe in to stay alive?
Which of these gives us energy as light and heat?
questions.explanation: The sun gives us light and heat.

questions.question: Which of these does a magnet pull?
How many planets go around the sun?
questions.explanation: Eight planets go around the sun.

questions.question: Yam and rice are rich in which food class?
questions.explanation: Yam and rice give us carbohydrates for energy.
